Principal Act Application Process

Applicant Responsibilities and Directions

Permalink: https://bit.ly/ACE-PA-applicant

The Principal Act provides a stipend to eligible principals and assistant principals in Alabama who successfully complete all APLDS program requirements. This guide walks you — the applicant — through completing your Principal Act Application in ACE, from logging in to signing your finished application. More information about the Principal Act and APLDS program can be found at alabamaprincipals.org.
Before you start: Start and complete your application only after your LEA notifies you that you are eligible for the Principal Act stipend.
STEP 1

Accessing ACE

  1. 1

    Go to https://aim.alsde.edu to log into your AIM account.

  2. 2

    Enter your ALSDE ID # or email address and password, then select Log In.

  3. 3

    Once logged in, click the tile labeled ACE to access the Certification Dashboard.

    Trouble logging in? For issues logging into an existing AIM account, contact the ALSDE help desk at 334-694-4777 or servicedesk@alsde.edu with your full name, ALSDE ID, and a description of the issue. Allow 3–5 business days for a response.
STEP 2

Start a Principal Act Application

When your LEA notifies you that you are eligible, start your application:

  1. 1

    From the dashboard, select New Application and select OK on the notice.

  2. 2

    On the Application Wizard welcome screen, select I'M READY, LET'S START.

  3. 3

    Select the Principal Act Approach, then click Next. (You will only see the approaches you are eligible to pursue.)

STEP 3

Configure the Application

After selecting the Principal Act Approach, answer the eligibility questions. Each is a Yes/No question that confirms you qualify for the Principal Act stipend. Answer them based on your situation and select Next after each.

  1. 1

    Select whether you are employed full-time as a principal or assistant principal. (The law's definitions of each are shown for reference.)

  2. 2

    Select whether you are employed as an interim principal or assistant principal.

  3. 3

    Select whether you are retiring at the end of the school year.

  4. 4

    Select whether your PowerSchool PL transcript reflects at least 30 APLDS Clock Hours between June 1 – April 30 of the current school year.

  5. 5

    Select whether your transcript reflects APLDS-approved early literacy (Grades K–3) and early numeracy (Grades K–5) professional learning, or is not applicable.

  6. 6

    Select whether you have completed all steps of the APLDS Evaluation System in the AIM Teaching Effectiveness application.

  7. 7

    When you have answered all questions, select Launch Application to create your application.

  8. 8

    When the application launches, it opens on the Confirm Personal Data screen. In the left panel, Provide Documentation lists two groups: Applicant Responsibility — the items you complete (Confirm Personal Data, Upload APLDS Transcript, Upload APLDS Evaluation) — and School System Responsibility, which your LEA completes. After your items are done, you finish under Review and Sign.

    Delete Application: The Delete Application button at the top removes this application entirely. Use it only if you start the application by mistake — a deleted application cannot be recovered. It is available only while the application is still in progress; once you complete and sign it, it can no longer be deleted.
STEP 4

Confirm Personal Data

Open Confirm Personal Data and review your information. This data comes from your AIM account — if anything is incorrect, update the information in your AIM account and refresh the application.

STEP 5

Upload APLDS Transcript

  1. 1

    Open Upload APLDS Transcript.

  2. 2

    Do not upload your transcript until all APLDS Clock Hours for the current school year have been awarded in the PowerSchool PL platform.

  3. 3

    Directions for downloading your PowerSchool PL transcript are available at alabamaprincipals.org/professional-learning-guidelines.

  4. 4

    Drag and drop your file or select Browse to upload it.

    Supported formats: PDF, PNG, JPG/JPEG, DOC/DOCX, TXT, TIFF, XLS/XLSX. Maximum 10 MB per file; password-protected/encrypted files cannot be uploaded.
STEP 6

Upload APLDS Evaluation

  1. 1

    Open Upload APLDS Evaluation.

  2. 2

    Do not upload your evaluation documentation until all steps of the APLDS Evaluation System have been completed and signed by your evaluator.

  3. 3

    Directions for accessing the APLDS Evaluation System are available at alabamaprincipals.org/evaluation-system.

  4. 4

    Upload your evaluation file the same way (drag and drop or Browse).

STEP 7

Review and Sign

Once your sections are complete, open Review and Sign, review your application, and sign.

After you sign, the application moves to Waiting Agency while your LEA completes the required attestations. No further action is needed from you at that point.
STEP 8

Checking Status

  • Check the ACE Portal for updates on your application.
  • You will receive message updates in the Message Center of the ACE Portal.
  • If you have questions, please contact your employing school system.
